correctness.rationale: For omitted white index sets I⊂A and J⊂B, a blue b_i sees p−1_{i∈I} whites and blue a_i sees q−1_{i∈J}. If p>=3, no blue vertex in B can ever force an A white (A white count cannot decrease through B-only changes), so p<=2, q<=2 necessary. If p=q=2 and I=J, all blue vertices see two opposite whites and process is stuck. Otherwise, a white-index difference supplies a first force for p=q=2 then p=2,q=1; 1+1 and smaller reduce inductively. Counting at most 2 omitted from each side, subtract C(n,2) aligned bad pairs, gives (x^n+n x^(n-1)+C(n,2)x^(n-2))²−C(n,2)x^(2n−4), with n=3=C6 boundary and minimum 2n−4. Independent adjacency/color-change exhaustive run checked every subset n3..7 (forcing totals 46,115,246,469,820) against statement and exact coefficients. Universal correctness is symbolic, not extrapolated.
